skipped.why: no loadable device: the engine has no bus-less device, no clock+display device, no lcd decode, no buttons (see engineNeeds)
not a display-driver device: counter seg7 part, needs new counter seg7 keys first (see counterSeg7Needs); AGENTS.md obsolete rule conflict: TI status OBSOLETE and it is the only part

pcf1179c: bus {"style":"none"} accepted on leddriver/lcddriver (load_bus requires an object with a style today)
clock section allowed together with display in lcddriver (converter_load.c loads clock for rtc only, display for led/lcd driver only), the rtc.c engine run for that kind
clock.powerOn: start time as a function of a field (MODE strap via pins.levels): 12-hour 1:00 AM, 24-hour 0:00; also applied by the reset action

display.lcd.decode: [{field, cells:[{pin,bp}], table:[strings of 0/1 per cell]}]: field value v lights cell i when table[v][i]=1; OR-ed with the RAM bits; several cells on one (pin,bp) allowed (A1/D1/E1/G1, A3/D3)
display.lcd.cells conditional: [{pin,bp,when:[conditions]}] lit while conditions hold (colon static/flash, AM, PM)
display.lcd.test: condition; while true every segment pin is driven opposite the frame level in every slot (all cells lit)

buttons section: S1 hour+1, S2 minute+1 (no carry to hours) and seconds:=0; debounce 65 ms (30-100), first repeat 1000 ms, then 4/s; TS low: counting stopped and all these times /64; ENABLE low disables; both keys: segment test while pressed, release (DATA not low) = reset to power-on state
glass: a bundled GENERIC-LCD-CLOCK-1:2 with 13 segment pins + BP1/BP2, colon (L1) and two new annunciator names AM and PM in the lcd kind
engineNeeds.counterSeg7: see spec § SN74143: segmentsActive, segmentsOutput open-drain (+ per-model counter_pin_open_drain), toggleEnable array, maxCount, latchOutputs, blank, rbi/rbo (latched, with BI term), decimalPoint; optional maxRise/maxFall extras

notes: Spec: planning/plan-56-data/specs/pcf1179-sn74143.md. Neither maker hosts its datasheet (NXP and TI URLs all 404): parts take no datasheet key. PCF1179C footprint = existing SOIC-28W. SN74143: glyphs 0-9 verified against both the p.2 figure and the p.7 table; MAX low at counter 9 with SCEI low; QA-QD show the latch (tPHL clock to Q is blank in the scan).
